results.title: Homework row turns tragic: 6-year-old LKG student dies, teacher seen slapping him on CCTV
results.description: The exact cause of death is yet to be established, with the post-mortem report awaited. Police are examining the footage and questioning those present as part of the investigation.

results.title: HMDA Plot Auctions See Strong Bidder Response
results.description: The last date for registration is August 31 and the auction will be held on September 2.
